title: AutoManifold: Agentic Design of Data Visualisation Algorithms via Manifold Embedding
abstract: arXiv:2611.13710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Manifold embedding for data visualisation is dominated by a small set of hand-designed state-of-the-art (SOTA) algorithms. Their design targets are fixed at development time, resulting in inflexible algorithmic behaviour that cannot be readily steered towards user-specified structural priorities. Hand-designing new embedding algorithms to address user priority requires highly specialised expertise and is time consuming. To address autonomous algorithm design tailored to user preference, we introduce an agentic algorithm generation pipeline AutoManifold. It composes new manifold embedding algorithms from a constrained vocabulary of affinity, cost, and optimisation primitives, supported by multi-agent large-language-model (LLM) orchestration. translated_title: AutoManifold：基于流形嵌入的数据可视化算法智能体化设计
translated_abstract: 数据可视化的流形嵌入领域目前由少数手工设计的最先进（SOTA）算法主导。这些算法的设计目标在开发阶段即被固定，导致其算法行为缺乏灵活性，难以根据用户指定的结构优先级进行调整。为满足用户需求而手工设计新的嵌入算法需要高度专业化的知识且耗时费力。为实现面向用户偏好的自主算法设计，我们提出了智能体化算法生成流水线 AutoManifold。该流水线从一组受约束的亲和度、代价与优化原语词汇表中组合生成新的流形嵌入算法，并由多智能体大语言模型（LLM）编排提供支持。AutoManifold 将其设计的每个阶段都基于用户指定的结构保持偏好进行条件化，并通过 LLM 引导、以度量指标为依据的迭代方式反复优化算法配置。
tldr: AutoManifold 提出了一种由多智能体大语言模型驱动的算法生成流水线，能够根据用户指定的结构保持偏好，从受约束的原语词汇中自动组合并迭代优化流形嵌入算法，实现面向用户偏好的数据可视化算法自主设计。
en_tdlr: AutoManifold introduces an agentic LLM-orchestrated pipeline that autonomously composes and iteratively refines manifold embedding algorithms from constrained affinity, cost, and optimization primitives, conditioned on user-specified structural preservation preferences for data visualization.
